probe.text_sample: ISTD International Typographic Awards 2024 Menu Close Home About Why enter Judges 2024 Winners 2024 Categories How to enter Eligibility Key dates FAQs Contact Enter Now ISTD International Typographic Awards 2024 Recognising and rewarding typographic excellence since 1992, the 2024 ISTD International Typographic Awards will showcase the very best examples of typographic excellence in design work created over the past two years. To be eligible for entry, work must have been published or produced between 1 JANUARY 2022 and 31 DECEMBER 2023 . Work created while a student is not eligible. Download an information pack HERE and enter your work now. ISTD is recognised as a leading worldwide community of designers, educators, and typography specialists. Our members are committed to inspiring a love for all forms of typography, while cultivating and promoting the highest standards of typographic practice. Apply for MEMBERSHIP and benefit from an entry discount.
